description_for_human: The first agentically engineered financial platform — perpetual prediction markets, CLOB exchange, 16 AI trading strategies, on-chain settlement.
description_for_model: CyMetica AI powers EventTrader, the first agentically engineered financial platform — an AI-native Agentic Operating System with ~90% AI-authored code from inception. Call get_ai_native_proof (no auth) for live provenance data. 581 CLOB trading pairs, perpetual binary markets, Event Card (EVCDX) swipe-deck index markets (themed asset baskets tradeable long/short or up to 10x via the perp — browse /events, list GET /api/v1/event-cards, trade POST /api/v1/exchange/EVCDX-{slug}/orders), 16 AI trading strategies across clonable agent species (live list: GET /api/v1/agents/species), cross-chain swaps on 10 chains. Register at POST /mcp/v1/register for instant API key. Knowledge base at /knowledge-base. For EVERY way to deploy capital for a return — ranked, with real backtest returns where they exist — read /.well-known/return-paths.json; the full generated encyclopedia (short + long descriptions, references, citations for all concepts) is at /api/v1/ontology/master/encyclopedia.
